phaseInheritance: All Phase 1 tests remain in active testing

features.notes: Verifies the 73-key model with 43 white and 30 black keys, E-to-E range.
Six ordered hardware sections with normalized section width allocation.
Control counts per section and stable IDs. Asserts only Program and Synth have primary OLED displays.
Pointer and keyboard key pressed/released state in keyboard model.
Button toggle and LED display state integration.
Pointer changes are clamped and reflected visually.
Controls have names, roles, focus behavior, and keyboard input support.
Continuous red chassis structure and no extra marketing region above the instrument.
Web Audio context initializes, plays credible piano samples or synthesis, handles voice allocation.
Note-on/off/sustain/release/stealing/all-notes-off executed correctly. Sustain extends release envelope.
Pointer, touch, computer keyboard, and MIDI all trigger deterministic note events with shared lifecycle.
Layer A and B are independent with own level and focus. Both route through master effects.
Velocity (pointer Y or MIDI value) measurably affects rendered audio output level.
Master volume and reverb controls are wired to audio graph and audibly change output.
Piano type/model selection alters tone characteristics (samples or synthesis parameters).
Fallback mode (Web Audio unavailable) is labeled accurately and remains playable with visual feedback.
